entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with S.T. No. 136 of 2023, arising out of Choudwar P.S.
Case No. 367 of 2021 pending before the Court of the learned District and Sessions Judge, Cuttack,
for alleged commission of offences under Sections 376(1)/506 of IPC.
3.

entities.text: Court of the learned District and Sessions Judge, Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge(LR & LTV), Cuttack, by order dated 22.06.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
4. Since the trial has already commenced, this Court is not inclined to entertain this bail application at this stage.
5. Leave is granted to the Petitioner to renew his prayer after examination of the victim.
6. Learned Court in seisin is requested to expedite the trial.
7. Registry is requested to communicate this order to the trial court.
8. Accordingly, this BLAPL stand disposed of.
